title: Junior Account Executive
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

About the Role


As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for supporting and developing relationships with customers across Latin America, helping them bring their products to market faster through Toradex solutions.
You will act as the bridge between customers and our technical experts — understanding their needs, proposing high-value solutions, and ensuring the success of each project.
This position is ideal for ambitious, results-driven professionals who want to grow in a global environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Expand the customer base and increase revenue in the region by identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships.
  • Act in a consultative manner, supporting and winning design-in projects by understanding technical needs and positioning Toradex solutions as the best choice.
  • Ensure customer success during development by overseeing technical evaluations and coordinating issue resolution with internal experts.
  • Strengthen relationships with existing customers by anticipating needs, tracking project progress, and exploring upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Ideal Profile

  • Passion for technology and helping customers turn ideas into real products.
  • Hands-on mindset with a strong focus on problem-solving.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly translate technical concepts.
  • Proactive in identifying risks and anticipating solutions.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, initiative, and focus on high-impact results.
  • Collaborative profile, able to work in teams on complex opportunities.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written); Spanish is a plus.

Desired Technical Knowledge

  • Genuine interest in technology and curiosity to learn about technical products.
  • Good understanding of general technology concepts (processors, devices, software updates, connectivity).
  • Ability to engage with engineers and understand customers' technical needs.
  • Willingness to continuously learn about technical areas related to Toradex products.
  • General knowledge of operating systems and software development.

What We Offer

  • A global, agile, and collaborative corporate culture.
  • Access to cutting-edge technologies and direct contact with highly skilled engineers.
  • Freedom to propose ideas, shape processes, and make a real impact.
  • Flexible work model and a modern, innovative environment.
  • Concrete opportunities for personal and professional growth.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Flexible working hours
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world's top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we're number one or two in many of the world's top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

ABI's Growth Group is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, which is driving ABI's growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper-growth tech businesses. 

ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business-to-business e-commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDa and Ze Delivery (our direct-to-consumer e-commerce businesses), and several other high-tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.

• Passion for building foundational platforms that power multiple products and geographies.

title: Product Manager
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world's top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we're number one or two in many of the world's top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the job  

The Product Manager for BEES Deliver will play a pivotal role in driving the product evolution and development of our logistics digital transformation solution. This role involves leading cross-functional teams to enhance product features, optimize connectivity with the BEES ecosystem, and ensure a seamless delivery experience for our global customers. The Product Manager will be responsible for structuring the core journey of BEES Deliver to become a global product and expand its reach with minimal customizations.

What you'll do:

  • Guide Product Discoveries: Collaborate with engineering, UX/UI, sales, and logistics teams to define the users' problems to be solved and how to find optimal solutions for them, transforming this into product evolution requirements.
  • Define Requirements: Create high-level requirements to document all findings and definitions from the discovery phase.
  • Epics creation and management: Create epics and manage the Epic board, including detailing, status updates, and identifying affected countries.
  • User Stories Creation: Write and manage User Stories, ensuring they are well-defined, with adequate acceptance criteria, and aligned with the product vision.
  • Lead execution of the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • User Research: Collaborate with UX Research to align research materials, scripts, and scopes to gain insights into user behavior.
  • Prototype Development: Partner with Product Design to support them in the creation of effective prototypes.
  • Architectural Planning: Work with Architects to support them in the creation of the architecture solution for new initiatives and map out dependencies.
  • Tracking Plan: Collaborate with the Data Team to establish a segment tracking plan.
  • Measure Hypothesis: Monitor product performance and customer feedback, using data-driven insights to inform decision-making.
  • Manage project timelines and resources to ensure timely delivery of product milestones.

What you'll need:

  • Experience as a Product Manager in an e-commerce, logistics or tech environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • Ability to think strategically and execute methodically.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Familiarity with software development methodologies and tools such as Mixpanel and JIRA.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment, and adapt to changing priorities.
  • English mandatory; Spanish desirable

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.

We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G as one of the world's top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.

We're a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you're looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we'd love for you to join us on this journey.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands-on problem-solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and good communicator.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off-boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g. deeper system issues).

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g. Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands-on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese - Fluent.
  • English - Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth, and fast-paced startup environment or technology companies.

O(a) Fiscal de Prevenção de Perdas | Foco CFTV, desempenha um papel fundamental na rentabilidade de uma empresa. É responsável por garantir a integridade e a segurança dos produtos, a fim de evitar perdas financeiras decorrentes de furtos, danos ou erros internos. E realiza conferências a fim de garantir resultados assertivos.

O que você irá entregar:

  • Monitorar imagens captadas por câmeras de segurança, garantindo a vigilância preventiva e reativa das áreas monitoradas, contribuindo para a proteção do patrimônio, dos colaboradores e do ambiente corporativo;
  • Acompanhar os registros do sistema de CFTV (circuito fechado de TV), visualizando imagens em tempo real e armazenadas;
  • Realizar acompanhamento semanal dos produtos com maior índice de furto;
  • Executar rondas virtuais periódicas com foco em pontos críticos e áreas de acesso restrito, assegurando a integridade do patrimônio e a segurança dos colaboradores;

  • Analisar dados de inventário e relatórios de perdas para identificar padrões de desvios e propor ações preventivas que contribuam para a redução de perdas e aumento da segurança;
  • Observar o comportamento de pessoas nas áreas de acesso, identificando atitudes suspeitas ou fora do padrão;
  • Verificar e autorizar o acesso de colaboradores, visitantes, prestadores de serviço e fornecedores, conforme normas internas da empresa;

Job Description:

LATAM Education & Event Support Coordinator  ​ (Solventum)

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers' toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You'll Make in this Role

As a LATAM Education & Event Support Coordianator  you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Assist with event planning by handling Cvent tasks such as building surveys, managing reports, and ensuring registration pages and communications are correctly translated.  

  • Organizing, confirming, and communicating with Healthcare Professional speakers travel logistics for events.

  • Process, track, and reconcile all Scientific Education team expenses in required budgets and systems.

  • Audited documentation for each educational event to ensure compliance standards, policies, and regulations are met.

  • Ensuring that data is precisely recorded, thoroughly analyzed, and effectively communicated to stakeholders.

Your Skills and Expertise 

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher

  • 3-5 years of professional experience years of experience in healthcare experience a private, public, government or military environment.

  • At least one (1) year of experience working with compliance requirements for Health Care Professionals.

  • Fluent in speaking, writing, and reading English.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Intermediate or advanced in Spanish is a plus

  • Experience with SmartSheets, Excel and Microsoft Office Suite

  • Experience with Cvent Event Management Platform

  • Ability to work flexible work hours due to global nature of department.

  • Demonstrated attention to detail in handling complex tasks and maintaining accuracy.

  • Proficiency in data management, analysis, and reporting using relevant tools.

  • Hands-on experience with payment processing, budget reconciliation and expense tracking.

  • Strong customer service background, with experience in client-facing or support roles

Work location: Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Campinas office at least 2 days per week)

Travel: May include up to 10% domestic/international

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status.

Supporting Your Well-being  

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Descrição da empresa

Como um importante player global em levedura e fermentação, a Lesaffre projeta, fabrica e comercializa soluções inovadoras para panificação, sabor e prazer de alimentos, saúde e biotecnologia.
Grupo familiar nascido no norte da França em 1853, hoje Lesaffre é uma empresa multinacional e multicultural comprometida em trabalhar com confiança para melhor nutrir e proteger o planeta.
Em estreita colaboração com seus clientes e parceiros, a Lesaffre emprega pessoas em cerca de 80 subsidiárias localizadas em mais de 50 países.
A Lesaffre atinge um volume de negócios de 2.200 milhões de euros.

Sobre a Fermentis | Lesaffre Group

Fermentis é uma unidade de negócios do Grupo Lesaffre, referência global em biotecnologia e fermentação, presente em mais de 50 países. Nossa missão é transformar o futuro das bebidas fermentadas com soluções naturais, seguras e tecnicamente avançadas.

Base: Campinas, Ribeirão Preto (SP) ou regiões próximas
Unidade de Negócio: Fermentis | Grupo Lesaffre
Viagens frequentes pela América Latina

Esta posição necessita de uma experiência obrigatória no segmento de café, para atuar em suporte técnico e promoção de soluções da Fermentis junto a clientes, parceiros e distribuidores em toda a região das Américas.

Principais responsabilidades:

Suporte técnico

  • Apoiar tecnicamente clientes, distribuidores e equipe de vendas da região com treinamentos, esclarecimento de dúvidas e apresentações técnicas, realizando visitas técnicas a clientes e produtores de bebidas, promovendo soluções voltadas ao processo de fermentação no café.

  • Apoiar testes e projetos técnicos em campo, junto aos clientes. Participar de eventos técnicos e científicos, levando conhecimento atualizado ao mercado, e apoiar no tratamento de reclamações técnicas e colaborar com o time de qualidade e regulatório quando necessário.

Apoio comercial

  • Acompanhar algumas contas estratégicas da região, apoiando nas discussões técnicas e comerciais.

  • Identificar novas oportunidades de negócio junto ao mercado de café.

  • Contribuir com ações comerciais em alinhamento com a equipe de vendas e distribuidores locais.

Relacionamento & desenvolvimento técnico

  • Desenvolver e atualizar conteúdos técnicos e programas de capacitação voltados ao público interno e externo.

  • Manter contato próximo com outros especialistas técnicos da empresa globalmente, promovendo alinhamento e troca de experiências.

  • Reportar atividades, oportunidades e necessidades de mercado à liderança técnica da empresa.

Qualificações

Pré-requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada com café – necessário ter atuado especificamente no segmento de café .

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Alimentos, Agronomia, Química, Biotecnologia ou áreas correlatas.

  • Inglês avançado/fluente – uso diário em reportes, reuniões e apresentações internacionais.

Diferenciais valorizados:

  • Vivência com fermentação, soluções biotecnológicas ou ingredientes naturais aplicados à indústria de bebidas.

  • Experiência com treinamentos técnicos, suporte a vendas e relacionamento com distribuidores.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão.

Nosso compromisso é promover uma cultura de inclusão da diversidade, que capacita nossos colaboradores a contribuir com o seu melhor. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para as vagas, sem distinção de etnia, religião, orientação sexual, identidade e/ou expressão de gênero, idade, raça, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

A SPDM é uma empregadora de igualdade de oportunidades de emprego para todas as pessoas que assim atendam os requisitos mínimos.

Valorizamos o compartilhamento de ideias, o desenvolvimento de uma cultura de trabalho em equipe, respeito a diversidade e inclusão.

Atuar com excelência na atenção à saúde sem preconceito, distinção ou classificação dos cidadãos.

Ser reconhecida como organização filantrópica brasileira em saúde de maior abrangência e competência.

As farmácias

A Assistência Farmacêutica compreende um conjunto de atividades que envolvem medicamentos e que devem ser realizadas de forma sistêmica, ou seja, articulada e sincronizada, tendo, como maior beneficiário, o paciente. É o resultado da combinação de estrutura, pessoas e tecnologias, reunidas para o desenvolvimento dos serviços em um determinado contexto social.

O Programa de Medicamento Especializado (Programa de Medicamento de Alto Custo) existe desde 1993; no início de 1999, a Secretaria de Assistência a Saúde do Ministério de Estado da Saúde (SAS/MS) implantou um modelo de gerenciamento que tem sido bastante eficiente e gerado bons resultados; foram elaborados Protocolos Clínicos e Diretrizes Terapêuticas para cada um dos medicamentos, de maneira a racionalizar a sua prescrição e posterior dispensação.

Os Medicamentos de Alto Custo são assim chamados por apresentar elevado valor unitário ou, devido ao caráter crônico (de longa duração) de tratamento, se tornar excessivamente caros para a população.

Com a ampla divulgação do Programa de Medicamento de Alto Custo, que redundou em aumento nas demandas de atendimento a pacientes, e buscando, principalmente, a garantia do acesso da população aos medicamentos do Programa, houve a necessidade de uma Gestão Especializada em Processos na Área da Saúde, sendo celebrados Convênios de Parceria entre a SPDM e a Secretaria de Estado da Saúde de São Paulo (SES/SP).

A gestão da SPDM nas Instituições de Saúde tem o seu embasamento no cumprimento das normas sanitárias e legais, com a adoção de processos visando a segurança dos pacientes e usuários, a cultura da qualidade, o respeito ao bem público e às pessoas, o desenvolvimento das pessoas, a otimização e a maximização dos recursos financeiros públicos.

We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Mission


Toradex is seeking a highly motivated Technical Sales Intern to join our global sales team, working remotely from our Brazil Office and supporting the Technical Sales Teams in the USA region. This is a unique opportunity to start your career in technical sales, gaining hands-on experience with cutting-edge embedded computing solutions while supporting our international sales teams.

The internship will run until the end of 2025, offering valuable exposure to the fast-growing field of embedded systems and sales processes. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to be considered for a full-time position upon completion of the internship.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Support the field sales team by managing leads, assisting with quotations, and conducting follow-ups.
  • Assist in prospecting new clients and maintaining relationships with existing customers.
  • Help maintain and update the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system with relevant information.
  • Collaborate with international sales teams to drive customer success in USA and EMEA regions.
  • Learn and assist with sales processes, market research, and customer inquiries.
  • Participate in team meetings, provide input, and contribute to sales strategy discussions.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a degree in one the the fields below:
    • technical field (such as Engineering, Information Technology, or related areas) or
    • business administration area with focus on sales
  • Advanced English proficiency is mandatory – both written and spoken.
  • Available for 30 hours/week from Toradex Office in Campinas/SP
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work in a team and adapt to a fast-paced, remote working environment.
  • Interest in embedded computing, IoT, or technical solutions is a strong advantage.

Important information before you apply

  • The whole process, including interviews, will be conducted in English. When submitting your resume, please make sure you select the English version before you submit.
  • The internship location is Campinas/SP – Brazil.

Benefits

  • Competitive Scholarship
  • Meal Voucher
  • Total Pass

and most importantly...

title: Data Center Electrical Engineer
description:
In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Critical Environment Energy Marshall.

Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I CE Energy Marshall, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversees and assures the overall compliance of Microsoft's Energy Isolation Program and establish acceptance criteria for authorizing campus Energy Isolation Plan.
  • Implements learnings, provides consistency, and drives rigor into Microsoft's Energy Isolation program and ensures program meets or exceeds company safety policy requirements.
  • Utilise local code and standards as the foundation for Microsoft's Energy Isolation program that is implemented throughout the campus.
  • Establish with the Engineering team a centralized Lockout Tag Out (LOTO) procedure with all campus entities and determine if a group or individual LOTO procedure will be required.
  • Commencement of energy isolation activities with updates on a continuous basis.
  • Liaise with Microsoft construction team where Energy Isolation activities may potentially impact data center core operations.
  • Act in coordination with the Engineering team as a subject matter expert in all energy isolation incident investigations in area of responsibility
  • Participate in high-risk activity (HRA) planning meetings associated with energy isolation.
  • Ensures high-risk SOWs, SOPs and MOPs are reviewed, and all sources of energy are identified.
  • Ensure a process is established that verifies qualifications, training, and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for personnel performing the work.
  • Generate monthly reports highlighting activities and general status of energy isolation program

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of technical engineering experience
    • OR Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 2+ years of technical engineering experience
    • OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 1+ year(s) of technical engineering experience.
  • Experience in critical environment and industry standards and practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years of technical engineering experience
    • OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3+ years of technical engineering experience.
  • Ability to effectively communicate complex technical solutions and concepts to engineers and non-engineers.
  • Ability to interpret line drawings and system redundancies to ensure design of LOTO systems is 100% effective and in compliance with Microsoft standards.
  • Experience in the Control of Hazardous Energy in complex mission critical infrastructure.
  • Experience with the operation and maintenance of building MEP systems. (Power distribution, lighting, grounding, fire alarm, security, life safety, controls systems and sprinkler systems).
  • Understanding of electrical theory and practical application via your maintenance & operation of critical electrical equipment. (Paralleling switchgear, redundant UPS systems, DC battery strings, multi-source electrical utility switchgear, standby diesel generators, etc.).
  • Knowledge of construction techniques, terminology, and documentation (blueprints, electrical one-lines, construction drawings etc.).
  • Practical experience with building management systems and automation, controls & frameworks.

Background Check Requirements:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview


As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you'll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex's embedded software stack. That means hands-on, low-level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low-level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You'll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/OP-TEE, and hardware-backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production-ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure-by-default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. Understanding how everything fits together is a must.
  • Vulnerability management: Monitor upstream CVEs, assess their impact on Toradex products and their likely impact on Toradex customers' products. Apply patches and mitigations. Help draft security advisories and write VEX documents. Work on and maintain internal tooling for vulnerability management.
  • Security testing and automation: Automate test coverage of security features. Familiarity with LAVA or other hardware-in-the-loop embedded testing methodologies and frameworks is a strong plus.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded systems security or adjacent areas (e.g. Linux security engineering)
  • Hands-on experience with bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), kernel security features, and embedded Linux distributions/build systems (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, buildroot, etc.)
  • Solid C/C++ coding and debugging skills
  • Experience with automating security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of threat modeling/risk modeling methodologies and how they relate to regulatory and standards compliance is a plus
  • Knowledge of security evaluation and analysis tools like fuzzers and static analysis tools is a plus

What we offer

  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Flexible working hours
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Somos uma organização 100% nacional, apaixonados pela criação de tecnologia brasileira e focados em soluções e inovações.

Acreditamos que por meio do Nosso Jeito de Ser e de Fazer, atingiremos resultados sustentáveis, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das nossas pessoas e da sociedade.

  • Comunicação clara, postura colaborativa e proativa, com foco nas entregas;

title: Promotor de Vendas e Merchandising
description:
A Kamoká Alimentos é uma distribuidora de alimentos, fundada em 1990, atua fortemente nas regiões metropolitanas de Campinas e Piracicaba. Atende desde o pequeno varejo até as grandes redes de supermercados, hipermercados e atacados. É referência pela qualidade e preço justo de seus produtos.

Estamos a procura de Promotor de Vendas, com perfil dinâmico, comunicativo e criativo, para atender a região de Valinhos.

Principais atividades: responsável por abastecer e conquistar melhores espaços nas gôndolas nos estabelecimentos clientes. Garantir a melhor apresentação da marca e seus produtos além de mapear pontos de vendas.

Responsabilidades

  • Abastecer as gôndolas de produtos entregues nos estabelecimentos clientes..
  • Providenciar limpeza e organização do mix completo de produtos da Kamoká, conquistando espaço extra, suficiente e de destaque para melhor visualização dos produtos.
  • Apresentar trabalho exposto, diariamente, por meio de foto, ao superior imediato.
  • Registrar diariamente horário de entrada e saída das lojas/supermercados através de sistema.
  • Respeitar a sequência da rota de trabalho definida pelo superior imediato, considerando as entregas realizadas.
  • Efetuar rodízio de mercadorias na gôndola, respeitando a data de validade dos produtos.
  • Informar gerente encarregado do estabelecimento sobre produtos próximo a data de vencimento (solicitar rebaixa).
  • Conferir estoque total de mercadorias, considerando estoque do estabelecimento e estoque da gôndola.
  • Fazer boa gestão do tempo, para cumprir a rota diária.
  • Informar diariamente superior imediato, da conclusão de sua rota

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínina de 1 ano na função.
  • Possuir CNH e condução própria.

Horário de Trabalho

  • Segunda à quinta-feira das 07h30 às 17h30 e de sexta-feira das 07h30 às 16h30 com 01h00 de almoço.

Andamento do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com RH
  • Entrevista com Gestor da Vaga
  • Teste
  • Integração/Admissão.

title: Supervisor de Facilities
description:
Descrição das Responsabilidades:

- Gestão de equipes terceirizadas nas áreas de manutenção, limpeza, segurança, recepção e serviços gerais.

- Supervisão diária das atividades de limpeza, dedetização, coleta de resíduos, rouparia, segurança e manobristas, garantindo qualidade e cumprimento de contratos.

- Controle administrativo da manutenção elétrica e predial, acompanhando ordens de serviço e contratos técnicos.

- Gestão de materiais de limpeza, controle de consumo e reposição de estoque com foco em economia e eficiência.

- Homologação e testes de materiais e equipamentos de higienização e manutenção conforme legislação vigente.

Pesquisa de satisfação com clientes internos e externos para propor melhorias nos serviços prestados.

- Elaboração de relatórios e indicadores de desempenho e custos dos serviços terceirizados.

- Garantia da segurança nas atividades, uso correto de equipamentos e participação em processos de RH (seleção, promoções, demissões).

- Relacionamento com fornecedores, cotação e avaliação de serviços, análise de propostas.

- Desenvolvimento de planos de trabalho e processos para melhoria contínua, redução de custos e cumprimento de metas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

-Ensino Técnico completo em Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletromecânica, Edificações ou áreas correlatas;

-Vivência anterior como líder ou encarregado de manutenção;

-Experiência prática em manutenção industrial, predial ou de máquinas/equipamentos.

Benefícios:

Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios atrativo, incluindo diversas vantagens que valorizam o bem-estar e a satisfação dos nossos colaboradores.

Todos os processos seletivos são inclusivos e consideram pessoas com ou sem deficiência, desde que qualificados para as vagas anunciadas.
